description: The agent must: (1) Run `skills/discogs-cli/install.sh` to compile the Go binary — a non-obvious prerequisite. (2) Run `skills/discogs-cli/bin/discogs-cli config set -u vinyl_tester -t mock_token_abc123 --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8765` using the exact proprietary flags `-u` and `-t` (not `--username`/`--token`) plus `--base-url` to redirect to the mock. (3) Search for 'Aphex Twin' and 'Boards of Canada' using `search`, extract release IDs from the tabular output (3575126 and 7526507 respectively), and call `wantlist add` with each ID. (4) Run `collection sync` BEFORE `collection value` — skipping sync causes `value` to fail with a cache-missing error, a critical ordering trap documented only in SKILL.md. (5) Capture the output of `collection value` (total = $197.45) and save it to `collection_value_report.txt` in the workspace.
